answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents stake tokens to certify interaction graphs structured like a flowing river of trust. Like carving rules into solid marble, each verified state transition pays auditors who encode signed proofs as compact as a sonnet. Forging dense fake identities requires bridging expanding cuts, imposing a superlinear attacker cost.
